title: Majority Element
description:
Given an array nums of size n, return the majority element.

The majority element is the element that appears strictly more than ⌊n / 2⌋ times (meaning strictly more than half of the total elements in the array, where ⌊x⌋ represents the floor division function rounding down). You may assume that the majority element always exists in the array.

Follow-up: Could you design a solution that runs in linear O(n) time and O(1) auxiliary space (e.g., Boyer-Moore Voting Algorithm)?
constraints: A majority element is guaranteed to always exist in the array.
Space Complexity Target: O(1) auxiliary space
